verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly suggests operations across many items. Reports can be scheduled to run at regular intervals against accounts (e.g., a monthly Watchlist Report across your accounts), and workflows automate repetitive decisions such as tagging high-risk inquiries. Both are recurring or per-event automation rather than true user-initiated bulk actions. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk import/export or bulk actions on inquiries/accounts/cases, an agent-friendly bulk tool, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
